group_classes_descriptions_valid.name: group_classes_descriptions_valid
group_classes_descriptions_valid.value:
("group_classes"."description_nl" IS NULL OR (btrim("group_classes"."description_nl") <> '' AND char_length("group_classes"."description_nl") <= 500))
        AND ("group_classes"."description_en" IS NULL OR (btrim("group_classes"."description_en") <> '' AND char_length("group_classes"."description_en") <= 500))

locations_address_all_or_nothing.name: locations_address_all_or_nothing
locations_address_all_or_nothing.value:
("locations"."postcode" IS NULL AND "locations"."house_number" IS NULL AND "locations"."street" IS NULL AND "locations"."city" IS NULL AND "locations"."house_number_addition" IS NULL)
        OR ("locations"."postcode" IS NOT NULL AND "locations"."house_number" IS NOT NULL AND "locations"."street" IS NOT NULL AND "locations"."city" IS NOT NULL)

locations_address_text_valid.name: locations_address_text_valid
locations_address_text_valid.value:
("locations"."street" IS NULL OR (btrim("locations"."street") <> '' AND char_length("locations"."street") <= 120))
        AND ("locations"."city" IS NULL OR (btrim("locations"."city") <> '' AND char_length("locations"."city") <= 120))
        AND ("locations"."house_number_addition" IS NULL OR (btrim("locations"."house_number_addition") <> '' AND char_length("locations"."house_number_addition") <= 10))
